name: Elisha
summary: The son of Shaphat who followed Elijah and took his place as prophet in Israel. Through him the LORD healed, fed and protected His people, and even his bones gave a dead man life.

key_moments.title: Called from the Plow
key_moments.description: Elijah found Elisha plowing behind twelve pairs of oxen and threw his cloak over him. Elisha killed his oxen to feed the people, then went after Elijah to serve him.

key_moments.title: Asks for a Double Portion
key_moments.description: Elisha asked that a double share of Elijah's spirit be on him, and he saw Elijah taken up. Then he struck the Jordan with Elijah's mantle, and the waters parted for him.

key_moments.title: Raises the Shunammite's Son
key_moments.description: Elisha promised a kind woman of Shunem that she would have a son, which came true. When the boy later died, Elisha prayed and stretched himself over the child until the boy sneezed and opened his eyes.

key_moments.title: Surrounded by Chariots of Fire
key_moments.description: When a Syrian army surrounded Dothan, Elisha prayed and his frightened servant saw fiery horses and chariots filling the mountain. The LORD struck the Syrians blind, and Elisha led them into Samaria, where they were fed and sent home.

key_moments.title: His Bones Bring a Dead Man to Life
key_moments.description: After Elisha died and was buried, a dead man was thrown into his grave. When the body touched Elisha's bones, the man came back to life and stood up.
